cases.name: Red Apple
cases.why: LiDAR from both 2019 and 2022, so the canopy that burned can be measured directly.

cases.name: Beachie Creek
cases.why: The 2020 Labor Day east-wind run: satellite detections trace it from about 1,100 acres on the afternoon of 7 September to about 115,000 acres by 2 a.m. the next morning. Post-fire LiDAR covers the whole burn.

cases.name: Rail Ridge
cases.why: Mapped almost daily (96 perimeters) and covered by LiDAR flown five years before the fire: spread over known canopy.
